[ Case study · Pak Asian Foods ]

From paper and WhatsApp to one system.

How a 4-year partnership replaced scattered order slips with an ERP, a field app and a verification desk that all speak the same language.

Client
Pak Asian Foods · FMCG
Since
2022 — ongoing
Built
Android app · Web admin · KPO
Stack
React Native · Node · PostgreSQL
[01] The problem

Order bookers wrote orders on paper and sent photos over WhatsApp. Head office re-typed every one, chased the missing ones, and had no view of where salesmen were or how close they were to target.

[02] What we built

Three parts, one core.

Field
Order app

An Android app for order bookers and salesmen. Works offline, syncs when signal returns, tracks routes by GPS and shows daily targets.

Management
Web admin

Orders, routes, targets and team performance in one place, by region and by salesman.

Quality
KPO desk

Every order is verified before it reaches dispatch, so bad orders stop at the door.

[ Process ]

How the work actually happens.

Four phases, one fixed price, and a working build every Friday. No surprises, no account managers, no lock-in.

01
Week 0 · free

Listen

A 45-minute call with both founders. We ask what is breaking, who it hurts, and what it costs you today. Sometimes the answer is that you do not need software at all.

You get
A written problem statement
02
Week 1

Architect

We design the data model and integrations, and agree a fixed timeline and a fixed price before any code is written.

You get
An architecture doc and a scoped plan
03
Every Friday

Build

Weekly builds on a live staging link you can click, test and show your team. You see progress, not status reports.

You get
A working system that grows weekly
04
Ongoing

Run

Monitoring, patches and scaling after launch. We stay on, and you can leave any time with everything.

You get
Full source and infrastructure, no lock-in
House rules

You own everything.
